newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan lead content of batteries sold in Aug dips.
newsitem.headline: Japan lead content of batteries sold in Aug dips.

text.p: The lead content of batteries sold in Japan in August was 21,647 tonnes, down 3.4 percent from the same month a year ago, the Japan Storage Battery Association said in its latest monthly report.

The lead content of August automotive battery sales was off 7.4 percent year-on-year at 16,447 tonnes, while for batteries for industrial uses, including forklifts and stationary power sources, lead content rose 21.1 percent to 3,163 tonnes.

Late last month the association announced that Japan's August domestic shipments of automotive batteries fell 7.2 percent year-on-year to 2,136,174 units. Data on lead content were not available at that time.
